description:
We are the AI Experience Framework (AIUX) team that builds the platform that powers ServiceNow's AI-first user interfaces. Using modern Lit-based web components, AIUX builds modular, reusable conversational experiences that serve as the technical foundation for conversation-first applications like Employee Slate. This role owns full-stack architectural decisions in a modern JavaScript/component-driven environment, working across AI integration, performance scale, and multi-team coordination — spanning our SSR runtime (server-rendered Lit components, versioned request routing, isolated execution pools) and the ServiceNow Glide platform layer it integrates with.
 What you'll do:
 Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and drive the full development lifecycle
 Build software that is simple to use, allowing customers to extend and customize functionality to meet their specific needs
 Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while enhancing the existing product suite
 Apply advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithms, OO design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations
 Raise the engineering bar through architecture reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and technical direction
 
 Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
 Completed no higher than a  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field
 1 - 3 years of professional software engineering experience with deep expertise in JavaScript and substantial experience in Java or a similar OO language (C++, C#, Go)
 Experience using JavaScript and the Web as a platform, reusability, and componentization
 Demonstrated experience with modern UI frameworks: Angular, React, Vue, or Lit
 Demonstrated knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, design patterns, and performance/scale considerations
 Demonstrated knowledge and experience with relational databases: development, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
 Demonstrated experience in server-side rendering and hydration, including the failure modes specific to isomorphic rendering (markup mismatches, browser-API leakage into server code)
 Demonstrated systems-level Node.js experience: process/worker isolation (V8 isolates or equivalent sandboxing), HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 semantics, reverse proxying, and designing for concurrent versioned rollouts
 Comfortable working across a JVM/Maven backend (Java, ServiceNow Glide platform conventions) in addition to a Node/TypeScript SSR stack
 Demonstrated experience as a senior individual contributor responsible for code quality, and mentoring
 Exposure to multiple technology stacks: Cloud Dev, Platforms, Web Dev, Frameworks, service-oriented architecture
 Preferred — AIUX Framework specific 
 Experience with build systems that emit multiple targets from one component source (server bundles vs. code-split browser bundles)
 Hands-on experience operating services in Kubernetes: deployment configuration, scaling, rollout/rollback, and incident response
 Experience building and maintaining observability tooling (Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerting) for production systems
 For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $121,051 - $136,000 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

 Work Personas 
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  
 Accommodations 
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 
 Export Control Regulations 
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
